_note: Verified on official regulator sites (rbi.org.in, sebi.gov.in) on 2026-11-03. Entries need url, ref_no as published and issued date; unknown fields stay null.

circulars.title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Eleventh Amendment Directions, 2026
circulars.summary: Amends the leverage ratio chapter of the commercial bank capital adequacy Directions to align with the Basel Committee's leverage ratio 2017 standard. Addressed to commercial banks; relevant to NBFCs only through bank funding costs.

circulars.title: Delegation of Compounding of certain Contraventions under FEMA, 1999 to Regional Offices of the Reserve Bank
circulars.summary: Compounding applications for certain FEMA contraventions (overseas investment, and borrowing, lending and guarantees) move to RBI Regional Offices. Addressed to AD Category-I banks and other authorised persons.

circulars.title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Forthcoming Instructions) Second Amendment Directions, 2026
circulars.summary: Amends Chapter IV (minimum capital requirements for operational risk) of the commercial bank Forthcoming Instructions Directions. Addressed to commercial banks.

circulars.title: Re-organisation of districts in the NCT of Delhi – Assignment and Review of Lead Bank Responsibility
circulars.summary: Assigns lead-bank responsibility for the three new Delhi districts (Old Delhi, Central North, Outer North) after Shahdara district ceased to exist. Addressed to lead banks only.

circulars.title: Implementation of Section 51A of UAPA, 1967: Updates to UNSC's 1267/ 1989 ISIL (Da'esh) & Al-Qaida Sanctions List: Removal of 03 Entries
circulars.summary: Three entries are removed from the UNSC ISIL (Da'esh) and Al-Qaida sanctions list, under Chapter IX of the KYC Directions, 2025. Regulated entities update sanctions screening.

circulars.title: Implementation of Section 51A of UAPA, 1967: Updates to UNSC's 1267/ 1989 ISIL (Da'esh) & Al-Qaida Sanctions List: Amendment of 03 Entries
circulars.summary: Identifiers on three entries in the UNSC ISIL (Da'esh) and Al-Qaida sanctions list are amended; the entries stay sanctioned. Regulated entities update sanctions screening.

circulars.title: Implementation of Section 51A of UAPA, 1967: Updates to UNSC's 1988 (2011) Taliban Sanctions List: Amendment of 05 Entries
circulars.summary: Five entries on the UNSC 1988 (2011) Taliban sanctions list are amended. Regulated entities, NBFCs included, update sanctions screening.

circulars.title: Extension of timeline for compliance with terms and conditions by Debenture Trustees (DTs) for carrying out activities outside the purview of SEBI
circulars.summary: Debenture trustees get six more months, up to 27 Apr 2027, to comply with the separate-business-unit conditions for non-SEBI activities. Addressed to debenture trustees, not issuers.

circulars.title: Rationalisation of periodicity of KYC review for FPIs
circulars.summary: Modifies the FPI Master Circular on KYC review periodicity and fee payment for FPIs, including GS-FPIs. Comes into force on 1 Dec 2026.

circulars.title: Extension of timeline with respect to compliance of Digital Accessibility Circulars
circulars.summary: SEBI regulated entities get until 31 Jan 2027 to appoint an IAAP auditor, run the accessibility audit of digital platforms and fix the findings. Addressed to exchanges, clearing corporations, depositories and intermediaries.

deadlines.title: SEBI FPI KYC review periodicity circular comes into force
SEBI digital accessibility: IAAP auditor, accessibility audit and remediation
SEBI debenture trustees: separate business unit compliance for non-SEBI activities
